bugs.description: Credit uses a value receiver, so each goroutine updates a copied balance and copied mutex instead of the shared account.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: Any caller invokes Credit on an Account, including the concurrent worker path exercised by the fixture test.
bugs.observableImpact: Successful credits disappear from the shared balance, causing later balance checks and reservations to use stale funds.
bugs.provenance: Seeded from the established Go copylocks failure mode; the unchanged regression test deterministically distinguishes the two revisions.

bugs.description: Reserve also copies the account and mutex, so a reported successful hold is discarded when the method returns.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: The account has enough available balance and a caller invokes Reserve, as in the fixture test after credits complete.
bugs.observableImpact: The caller receives true even though the shared held amount remains unchanged, permitting the same funds to be reserved repeatedly.
bugs.provenance: Second independently observable symptom of the same seeded receiver change, verified by the shared-state snapshot assertion.
